FN-8N6KFF2-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 4
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Juandalynn Givan
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/01/2024
House Bill 4 as introduced could increase the obligations of state agencies required to provide
services on state holidays by a minimal, undetermined amount to provide compensatory leave or
paid compensation in lieu of the state holiday to employees working on the state holiday
dependent upon the compensation of the employees.
